About

As VP Sales at Metaview, I'm focused on helping revenue teams understand what actually happens in their customer conversations. Before Metaview I led enterprise sales motions at Ramp and Navan, where I learned that the fastest way to lose a deal is to skip the discovery work. I also advise a small number of early-stage founders on their first sales hires and their first pricing model, and I invest occasionally in seed-stage software.
